members.name: banking_intents_v8
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent best describes what the customer is asking about? Pick exactly one.

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a card the customer has received: how to activate it, or activation is failing.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open or use an account; whether children/teenagers can have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or a smartwatch with the card, including topping up through Apple Pay or Google Pay.
criteria.atm_support: Finding ATMs: where the nearest ATM is, which ATMs accept the card.
criteria.automatic_top_up: The auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up, how it works, its limits.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: The customer made a bank transfer and their own account balance/dashboard has not changed or updated; includes 'How long does a transfer from a UK account take? I just made one and it isn't showing up'.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Customer deposited a cheque or cash and it is not showing in the balance or is taking long to clear.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee, or the customer was told a transfer is not possible / not allowed (e.g. 'suddenly being told it is not possible', 'the transfer to an account wasn't allowed').
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop or reverse a transfer or transaction they made (e.g. sent to wrong account).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or has expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted / can be used (shops, merchants, countries).
criteria.card_arrival: Card has been ordered but has not arrived yet; where is my card; tracking a card that was sent.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery to a given place or by a certain date, expedited delivery, before ordering.
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card to the account/app, including re-adding a found card or making a newly arrived card appear in the app.
criteria.card_not_working: The physical card is not working in general: it won't work, never goes through, can't be used, tried multiple times or in several places, without the customer saying it was 'declined'. Not contactless or virtual card issues.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a card payment/purchase; why paying by card cost extra.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: The customer says there is a payment/purchase/charge or transactions they did not make or do not recognise, without claiming their card or details were stolen or copied (they may ask whether to put the card on hold to be safe); includes a generic 'unknown charge'; excludes small ~£1/$1 extra charges.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The customer complains that the exchange rate they got/applied was wrong or incorrect (on a purchase, payment or in general, e.g. 'the rate I got is incorrect'), unless it was clearly on an ATM cash withdrawal.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fees for withdrawing cash at an ATM; was charged for a cash withdrawal.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: The app/statement shows a cash withdrawal or cash the customer did not take or receive (e.g. 'some cash showing up on my app', 'a cash balance I did not receive'). Not when the ATM gave less cash than requested (wrong_amount_of_cash_received).
criteria.change_pin: How to change, set or choose the card PIN.
criteria.compromised_card: The customer believes their card DETAILS were stolen or copied, or someone else is using their card/details (even if they mention transactions they didn't make as evidence), wants to report possible fraudulent activity, or wants the card frozen because someone is using it. If the physical card itself was stolen, use lost_or_stolen_card.
criteria.country_support: Which countries are supported; in which countries the service is available or a card can be obtained; whether the service works in a given country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: The customer says a card payment/purchase was declined, rejected or refused (uses words like declined/rejected/not accepted).
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal was declined / not authorised.
criteria.declined_transfer: The customer says a transfer was declined or rejected.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit on the account the customer does not recognise or did not set up.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions of disposable virtual cards (how many uses, who can get them, rules).
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, phone, account information.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees for exchanging currency; extra charges on currency exchange.
criteria.exchange_rate: Informational questions about exchange rates: what rates are used, where to find them, current rate for a currency, weekend rates, discounted rates. Not complaints that a rate applied was wrong.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange/convert currencies in the app, which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: The customer asks about a small extra charge on their statement of about £1/$1/€1 (pending or posted, even if they don't recognise it), or asks why they were charged an extra amount/extra fee with no stated cause (not a card purchase fee, ATM, transfer or exchange fee). A generic 'unknown charge' with no amount is NOT this.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed, did not go through or keeps giving an error; cannot make a transfer; also a mortgage or flat purchase payment that shows an error.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies the account can hold or exchange; receiving or holding money in other currencies.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: About the PIN of a card they have or are getting: cannot find the PIN, PIN not received yet, do I have a PIN. (Changing or choosing a PIN is change_pin.)
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/second/spare card, cards for family members.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or order a (non-disposable) virtual card; where the virtual card is.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The physical card itself was lost or stolen ('I believe my card has been stolen', 'I lost my card'); reporting it; found a lost card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone was lost, stolen or left behind; using the account without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Getting or ordering a physical card: how to get/order a card to use in stores, card fees, whether a new card is free, mailing a card abroad.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode/login code; resetting the passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment or purchase is still pending or hasn't gone through yet; 'I made a payment but it's still pending'.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is pending / transaction in progress after using an ATM.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending, still processing, not yet available, or taking long to arrive.
criteria.pending_transfer: A specific transfer is pending, still processing, not cleared, or hasn't arrived yet: one the customer made, or money transferred to them that they can't see yet; asking how much longer to wait for it.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked after entering it wrong too many times; unblocking.
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money from others or getting paid into the account: can friends send me money (in any currency), how to receive a payment, adding/receiving my salary.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the customer is waiting for has not appeared in the account.
criteria.request_refund: How to request/get a refund for something bought.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was returned/reverted back to the account.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (Visa, Mastercard, credit cards) and currencies are supported for top-ups or payments.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: How to top up or deposit using cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up attempt failed, didn't go through, was declined or gave an error.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups: maximum/minimum amounts, how often.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up went through or was credited and then the money went back or vanished; the top-up was reverted, cancelled or returned; or a top-up didn't work and the customer doesn't understand what happened to the money.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Topping up with a debit or credit card: how to do it, which card to use; also when the customer explicitly says they used their card to top up and the money has disappeared/is gone.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Charged twice / duplicate charge for one payment.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a transfer, or a higher fee for sending money/doing banking abroad.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account from another bank/account; ways to add money.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The customer sent money to another person or account and it hasn't arrived there: the recipient (friend, son, landlord, retailer) doesn't have it, or a domestic/in-country transfer made a day or more ago, with account details confirmed or double-checked, still hasn't gone through or isn't showing up.
criteria.transfer_timing: General questions about how long transfers take (domestic, international, from the US/Europe), not about a specific delayed transfer.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification is failing or the customer cannot complete it.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity, which documents are needed, how long verification takes.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Showing or verifying where the money in the account comes from (source of funds), or questions about how the money in the account is protected/secured.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or the card used for top-ups; the top-up verification code.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: The virtual card is not working or being declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; wanting or choosing specifically a Visa or a Mastercard card (e.g. 'I want to get a Visa card', 'I prefer a Mastercard').
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification or personal information is required.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave a different amount of cash than requested/recorded.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: The exchange rate for cash withdrawals/ATMs abroad: the rate applied to a cash withdrawal was wrong, or questions about rates when getting cash (e.g. weekend rates for getting cash, rate at foreign ATMs).

criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: [Fees and exchange] Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: [Fees and exchange] Fees for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: [Top-ups] How to top up or deposit using cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: [Top-ups] A top-up attempt failed, didn't go through, was declined or gave an error.
criteria.top_up_limits: [Top-ups] Limits on top-ups: maximum/minimum amounts, how often.
criteria.top_up_reverted: [Top-ups] A top-up went through or was credited and then the money went back or vanished; the top-up was reverted, cancelled or returned; or a top-up didn't work and the customer doesn't understand what happened to the money.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: [Top-ups] Topping up with a debit or credit card: how to do it, which card to use; also when the customer explicitly says they used their card to top up and the money has disappeared/is gone.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: [Payments, withdrawals and refunds] Charged twice / duplicate charge for one payment.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: [Fees and exchange] A fee was charged on a transfer, or a higher fee for sending money/doing banking abroad.
criteria.transfer_into_account: [Transfers] How to transfer money into the account from another bank/account; ways to add money.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: [Transfers] The customer sent money to another person or account and it hasn't arrived there: the recipient (friend, son, landlord, retailer) doesn't have it, or a domestic/in-country transfer made a day or more ago, with account details confirmed or double-checked, still hasn't gone through or isn't showing up.
criteria.transfer_timing: [Transfers] General questions about how long transfers take (domestic, international, from the US/Europe), not about a specific delayed transfer.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: [Account, identity and currencies] Identity verification is failing or the customer cannot complete it.
criteria.verify_my_identity: [Account, identity and currencies] How to verify identity, which documents are needed, how long verification takes.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: [Account, identity and currencies] Showing or verifying where the money in the account comes from (source of funds), or questions about how the money in the account is protected/secured.
criteria.verify_top_up: [Top-ups] Verifying a top-up or the card used for top-ups; the top-up verification code.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: [Card problems and security] The virtual card is not working or being declined.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: [Card delivery, ordering and PIN] Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; wanting or choosing specifically a Visa or a Mastercard card (e.g. 'I want to get a Visa card', 'I prefer a Mastercard').
criteria.why_verify_identity: [Account, identity and currencies] Why identity verification or personal information is required.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: [Payments, withdrawals and refunds] The ATM gave a different amount of cash than requested/recorded.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: [Fees and exchange] The exchange rate for cash withdrawals/ATMs abroad: the rate applied to a cash withdrawal was wrong, or questions about rates when getting cash (e.g. weekend rates for getting cash, rate at foreign ATMs).
